LanguageData.Bullet_DMS_AMR.label: heavy rifle bullet
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_MiniMachineGun.label: Riot machinegun bullet
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotRevolver.label: 20 gauge rubber slug
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotRevolver.description: A 20 gauge rubber slug. It arrives as one heavy impact rather than a spread, which puts someone on the ground and rarely does worse than that. Armor plating shrugs it off entirely.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotRevolver_Buck.label: 20 gauge buckshot
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotRevolver_Buck.description: A lethal 20 gauge pellet load. The revolver was never meant to be a fighting weapon, but nobody told the cylinder that.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotRevolver_Slug.label: 20 gauge slug
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotRevolver_Slug.description: A single lead slug loaded to a heavier charge than the cylinder was designed around. It carries much further than shot and will crack a light mech shell, at the price of a wrist that regrets every round.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotShotgun.label: 4 gauge rubber slug
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotShotgun.description: A 4 gauge rubber slug. It delivers a crushing, non-penetrating impact intended to knock down a target without killing them. Ineffective against armor plating.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotShotgun_EMP.label: 4 gauge EMP shot
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotShotgun_EMP.description: A 4 gauge casing carrying a discharge capacitor in place of shot. It dumps its charge into whatever it strikes, seizing up mechanoid systems without leaving a mark on flesh.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotShotgun_Breach.label: 4 gauge breaching round
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_RiotShotgun_Breach.descriptio: A solid steel breaching slug loaded heavy and meant to be put into a hinge or a lock from arm's length. It transfers everything it has into the structure it strikes, and it does so to exactly one thing at a time.
LanguageData.DMS_ElephantGun.label: Elephant Rifle
LanguageData.DMS_ElephantGun.description: Single-shot high caliber hunting rifle. While made to hunt big game or stop large hostile lifeforms with sheer kinetic energy, it is also used by early industrial colonies against mechanoids thanks to its simple manufacture requirements.
LanguageData.DMS_ElephantGun.tools.grip.label: grip
LanguageData.DMS_ElephantGun.tools.barrel.label: barrel
LanguageData.DMS_ElephantGun.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Elephant Rifle
LanguageData.DMS_ElephantGun.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.DMS_ElephantGun.tools.barrel-1.label: barrel
LanguageData.DMS_KnuckledusterRevolver.label: Knuckleduster Revolver
LanguageData.DMS_KnuckledusterRevolver.description: A miniature self-defense weapon commonly found on mid-worlds, it barely takes up any space when folded. Knuckledsters accept multiple calibers and may also be used as brassknuckles in a pinch.
LanguageData.DMS_MiniMachineGun.label: Riot LMG
LanguageData.DMS_MiniMachineGun.description: Pistol caliber machinegun designed for colony defense. The Riot LMG can cut down unarmored enemy hordes and prisoner riots with ease.
LanguageData.DMS_MiniMachineGun.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.DMS_MiniMachineGun.tools.barrel.label: barrel
LanguageData.DMS_Revolver.label: Riot Revolver
LanguageData.DMS_Revolver.description: S double-action revolver designed to load shotgun ammo. It was designed for personal defense purposes but soon became a favored sidearm for mech solders because it can be used against most enemy types at the same time.
LanguageData.DMS_Revolver.tools.grip.label: grip
LanguageData.DMS_Revolver.tools.barrel.label: barrel
A less-lethal slug that bruises and knocks down instead of killing. What the revolver was sold with, and what most of its owners never bother to change.
A lethal spread of pellets for when the situation stops being a disturbance and starts being a fight. Slightly harder to place than a rubber slug.
A single lead slug that carries much further than shot and punches through light plating. The heavier charge makes the revolver slower to bring on target.
LanguageData.DMS_Revolver.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.DMS_Revolver.tools.barrel-1.label: barrel
LanguageData.DMS_RiotShotgun.label: Rifled slug gun
LanguageData.DMS_RiotShotgun.description: A high caliber rifled shotgun manufactured with stamped components designed for riot operations and disabling hostile mechs.
LanguageData.DMS_RiotShotgun.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.DMS_RiotShotgun.tools.barrel.label: barrel
LanguageData.DMS_RiotShotgun.comps.CompAmmoSwitch.amm: A single rubber slug that knocks a target down instead of killing it. The standard round for riot work and for taking prisoners alive.
A lethal spread of pellets for close work against unarmored flesh. Marginally harder to place than a rubber slug.
A capacitor slug that discharges on impact, shorting out mechanoid systems instead of destroying them. It does nothing at all to flesh, and the heavy payload cuts the effective range short.
A solid slug meant to be fired into a door or a thin wall from arm's length. It will open a way in where nothing else will, and it is close to useless at any other distance.
LanguageData.DMS_RiotShotgun.tools.stock-1.label: stock
LanguageData.DMS_RiotShotgun.tools.barrel-1.label: barrel
LanguageData.DMS_SurvivalRifle.label: Survival rifle
LanguageData.DMS_SurvivalRifle.description: Foldable rifle issued to war machine crew members in case of emergency. Accepts multiple common calibers.
LanguageData.DMS_SurvivalRifle.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.DMS_SurvivalRifle.tools.barrel.label: barrel
